approval.scope: Only pure DECISION sites with enumerated outputs; leave MIXED and GENERATION unchanged. Preserve all externally observable fields.

sites.downstream: Prints recipe JSON (name, ingredient names and amounts, steps), blank line, result.usage and result.finishReason; main().catch(console.error) handles errors.
sites.reason: The fixed prompt generates a lasagna recipe with arbitrary strings. A structured schema does not make these enumerated decisions. There are no pure DECISION sites matching approval.

options.benefit: Preserves generation and all diagnostics; no change in model cost or latency.
options.risk: No migration risk; existing provider behavior remains.
